controlled_spatial_evidence.recapture_note: Captured against a fresh loopback 17.6.0 stack seeded with deterministic local roles. Every assigned row is a public read, so no mutation, upload, or token differential runs for this family. GeoLevel and GeoZone are empty on a fresh stack because the evidence seed creates no spatial rows, so the three routes that resolve a target through GeoZone.objects.get_or_404 or GeoLevel.objects.get_or_404 -- zone, zone_datasets, and spatial_coverage -- each answer 404. The fourth absent-target route is different: zones runs GeoZone.objects.in_bulk and then an unguarded list comprehension over the requested ids, so an absent id raises KeyError and that route answers 500 instead; the differential asserts the typed error mapping for it rather than a body. Granularities is never empty, because spatial_granularities appends the hardcoded BASE_GRANULARITIES literal to the GeoLevel rows, so it answers the two base entries (poi, other). Zone and level identifiers are percent-encoded exactly once by the connector's own wire tests, which emit fr%3A1100001 for fr:1100001.
